lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Rounded plate (patch 1) to middle panel (patch 5), about 25 deg, convex on the 1/5 outer skin. In the sections at 25/50/75% the dot sits on the outer skin: the nearest point is 0.02 to 0.44 mm away (0.44 at the 25% cut, by a hole edge), the depth error is about 0, and the material runs +5.7 mm along the bisector, which matches t. Across 10 stations the apex is 0 to 0.7 mm off sideways, which is expected for a shallow large-radius arc, and its depth is within 0.03 mm. The line runs the full 97 mm panel-width fold (99.3 mm, with ends at the panel edges in the face-on close-up). The plate 1 ears beyond the panel width are flat plate, not fold.
